Definition: {a son (as a builder of the family name), in the widest sense}
BiblicalUsage: In the Bible ben means son, and it appears 10 times across the Bible. Daniel speaks of the sons of men and the children of the captivity, and Ezra records the offerings of the sons of the captivity.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe "son" in Daniel and Ezra is a family word — the children of the captivity were still God's children, even far from home. That is why I keep coming back to it: ben is not a word to rush past.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
